t: Titan 1500W SDS Plus hammer drill with 22 piece accessory set delivers high-impact performance for heavy-duty drilling and chiselling tasks. The powerful corded hammer drill is designed for builders and plumbers working on demanding masonry, concrete and steel installations, with variable speed allowing the power to be matched to the material. 4-function capability allows quick switching between drilling, hammer drilling, chiselling and chisel adjustment. An anti-sand and stone bottom cover helps extend motor life, and the magnesium gearbox housing ensures efficient heat dissipation and durability, whilst an anti-vibration and auxiliary handles improve user comfort during prolonged use. Also equipped with a safety clutch to protect against sudden bit jams. Supplied 19 drill bits, 3 chisels, depth gauge, dust cap and carry case.
b: Drill, Hammer Drill, Chisel & Chisel Adjustment
